name: list_models
description: List all public models available on Replicate, paginated via cursor; returns owner, name, description, run count, and latest version id for each model.

name: model
description: Fetch metadata for a specific Replicate model by owner and name, including description, visibility, run count, latest version, and GitHub URL.

name: model_versions
description: List all published versions of a Replicate model by owner and name; returns version ids, creation timestamps, and input/output schema for each version.

name: model_version
description: Fetch full metadata for a specific Replicate model version by owner, name, and version_id, including the complete input/output OpenAPI schema and Cog version.

name: search_models
description: Search public Replicate models by keyword query; returns matching models with owner, name, description, and run count.

name: collections
description: List all curated Replicate model collections (e.g. "text-to-image", "speech-to-text"); returns collection slug, name, and description.

name: collection
description: Fetch models belonging to a specific Replicate collection by slug (e.g. "text-to-image"); returns the collection description and a list of model objects.

name: create_prediction
description: Start a Replicate model run by submitting a version id and input object; returns a prediction id and status that can be polled with the prediction tool until output is ready.

name: prediction
description: Poll the status and retrieve output for a Replicate prediction by id; returns status (starting/processing/succeeded/failed/canceled), output URLs, and logs.

name: list_predictions
description: List your recent Replicate predictions in reverse chronological order, paginated via cursor; returns prediction id, model version, status, and creation timestamp.

name: list_deployments
description: List your Replicate model deployments (dedicated, auto-scaled endpoints), paginated via cursor; returns owner, name, current model version, and scaling config.

name: account
description: Fetch your Replicate account details including username, name, GitHub URL, and account type.

name: hardware
description: List available Replicate hardware types (CPU, GPU SKUs) with their names and SKU identifiers; use to select hardware when creating a deployment.
